value.rationale: Exact line coalescence and peak counting are natural observables of non-Poisson stochastic spectroscopy. The result proves absence of an intermediate three-peak regime and a nontrivial factor 1.7518 increase in detuning threshold under Erlang-two rather than exponential residence times at the same mean. Universal algebraic root control, not a routine isolated substitution, is required; the sharp boundary enables parameter inference and discrimination of residence-time statistics.
